rules_note: Kaggle UMUD external-data rules still have to be re-read before any download. A public URL is not admission.
hard_rules: missing physical scale cannot support a millimetre claim
unchecked overlap cannot be called an external test

sealed_benchmark_rank.task_and_annotation_type: experimental fascicle tracks; repeated expert labels described by later DUSTrack use (5 participants, 18 frames, 3 experts, 3 days)
sealed_benchmark_rank.participant: multiple; adjacent frames are not independent
sealed_benchmark_rank.why_this_rank: First sealed external benchmark: participants and repeated human traces, not a training dump.

sealed_benchmark_rank.task_and_annotation_type: GM samples A/B and TA sample C for Simple Muscle Architecture Analysis; dense masks not confirmed
sealed_benchmark_rank.participant: sample images, not a cohort claim
sealed_benchmark_rank.human_or_algorithm_labels: analysis macro inputs; confirm before calling them expert GT
sealed_benchmark_rank.why_this_rank: Non-network geometry baseline. Confirm annotation type before any segmentation use.

sealed_benchmark_rank.task_and_annotation_type: local orientation and streamlines; human ROI and aponeurosis
sealed_benchmark_rank.physical_scale_source: paper states physical pixel resolution; not re-measured here
sealed_benchmark_rank.raw_image_or_overlay: de-identified images described by the paper
sealed_benchmark_rank.human_or_algorithm_labels: human ROI; algorithm streamlines are not expert GT
sealed_benchmark_rank.why_this_rank: Local-orientation contrast for R2. Not a fully automatic multi-device benchmark.

sealed_benchmark_rank.version: current OSF/GitHub package; Zenodo Examples record 7866598 is not the training archive
sealed_benchmark_rank.task_and_annotation_type: apo/fasc segmentation then PA/FL/MT; paper mean difference is not MAE and is not S
sealed_benchmark_rank.human_or_algorithm_labels: mixed until the current archive is parsed; model outputs are pseudo-labels
sealed_benchmark_rank.duplicate_and_provenance_status: overlap with competition and Frundles weights unchecked
sealed_benchmark_rank.why_this_rank: Full-pipeline reproduction after the three measurement benchmarks above. Not a clean held-out set by default.

other_roles.limit: Segmentation or orientation supervision only after overlap audit. Not an external test.
Overlay strokes are not clean masks. Already used in Dice fine-tunes that were not promoted.
Score a frozen recipe once. Do not select on it. The panoramic ACSA set is not architecture labels.
ACSA masks are not fascicle masks. ACSA accuracy is not a PA or FL result.

reading_order: Varma and Simon 2006, BMC Bioinformatics, nested selection
Cawley and Talbot 2010, JMLR, selection overfitting
UltraTrack, UltraTimTrack, DUSTrack only when a real sequence is the question
